BackstoryDef.title: furnace stoker of the pavilion
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] spent years feeding the Pavilion's furnaces, learning to read the heat by the color of the flame. Apprentices who misjudge it ruin a batch of pills; [PAWN_pronoun] ruined only one, and still remembers its price.

BackstoryDef.title: herb runner
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] ran herbs from the mountain terraces to the Pavilion's cauldrons, faster than any rival guild. A herb loses its qi by the hour, and the Pavilion pays by freshness.

BackstoryDef.title: pavilion alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is a full alchemist of the Heavenly Cauldron, entitled to refine pills under the Pavilion's seal. The seal means the pill is real, the dose is right and the price is not negotiable.

BackstoryDef.title: pill taster
BackstoryDef.description: Before a new recipe is sold, someone has to swallow it. [PAWN_nameDef] tasted pills for the Pavilion for a decade and survived all but one, which [PAWN_pronoun] survived anyway.

BackstoryDef.title: cauldron master
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] masters a cauldron of the Pavilion, with apprentices to feed the fire and alchemists to grind the herbs. A cauldron master signs each batch; a bad batch costs the signature.

BackstoryDef.title: material hunter
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] hunted rare materials for Ning Yuhuo, the fire alchemist with phoenix blood: beast cores, poison herbs, metals from the Rim's wrecks. The Pavilion pays well for anything nobody has refined before.

BackstoryDef.title: grand alchemist
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] is one of the Pavilion's grand alchemists, trained by Mo Qinghua, who never leaves the cauldron and is said to be the only one able to refine soul pills. [PAWN_pronoun] speaks little and refines a lot.

BackstoryDef.title: keeper of the ledger
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] keeps the Pavilion's ledger for Qian Wanli, the jovial master who has no official enemies and knows who bought what. Every debt in Jiuxiao is written there, including the ones the debtors forgot.

BackstoryDef.title: pavilion auctioneer
BackstoryDef.description: [PAWN_nameDef] learned the trade from Hu Xiaoman, the fox-blooded auctioneer who sells a secret with every lot. Now [PAWN_pronoun] travels with the Pavilion's caravans, selling everything and buying anything from the Rim.
